tok 1.0 "Car Service"

pool police "Police car service app"
  lane system "System"
    start serviced "Service successfully done"
    task check "Check if the car is still registered"
    xor registered "Car registered?"
    task notify "Notify the owner"
    eventgw wait
    catch visit "Owner comes to service" message="Owner comes to service"
    catch late "30 days passed" timer=P30D
    task fine "Fine the owner"
    end fined "Owner fined"
    end notregistered "No reminder needed"
    and split
    task status "Send status updates via email"
    and joined
  lane owner "Car owner"
    task pay "Pay through the app"
  lane mechanic "Mechanic"
    task problems "Enter the problems of the car"
    task repair "Repair the car"
    task success "Enter that the repair was successful"
    task next "Enter the time for the next service"
    end done "Service completed"

flow serviced -> check -> registered
flow registered -> notify "yes"
flow registered -> notregistered "no" default
flow notify -> wait
flow wait -> visit
flow wait -> late
flow late -> fine -> fined
flow visit -> problems -> split
flow split -> status
flow split -> repair
flow status -> joined
flow repair -> joined
flow joined -> pay -> success -> next -> done
